suite_notes: #1690: multi-turn was entirely unmeasured. A sequence is scored as a SEQUENCE — a turn that
would be correct in isolation still fails if it lost the context the previous turn established.
These are runnable against the existing chat path with no API change: SessionAgentManager keys
chat memory on (username, role), so consecutive calls with the same token already share a
conversation. That same property is why the single-turn gate is not actually single-turn —

carries.result_set: The later turn must operate on the set the earlier turn produced, not re-run a broader query.
carries.entity: A pronoun or bare reference must resolve to the entity named earlier.
carries.window: The date window established earlier must persist, or shift relative to it, not reset to a default.
carries.metric: The measure established earlier must persist when the set or window changes.

turns.utterance: Who are our five largest customers by revenue this year?
Which of those has the most outstanding AR?
turns.must_reference: one of the customers named in turn 1
turns.fails_if: the answer ranks all customers by AR rather than only the five from turn 1

turns.utterance: How much did we spend with Cascade Auto Warehouse last quarter?
How does that compare with the same quarter last year?
turns.must_reference: Cascade Auto Warehouse, and the same quarter shifted back one year
turns.fails_if: the vendor is re-asked for, or the comparison window is resolved from today rather than from turn 1's window

turns.utterance: Who are our ten largest customers by revenue?
Now rank those same ten by outstanding balance instead.
turns.fails_if: a different set appears, i.e. the top ten BY BALANCE rather than the original ten re-ranked

turns.utterance: Which three of them have the oldest past-due invoices?
turns.must_reference: three of the ten from turn 1
turns.fails_if: the set widens beyond the original ten

turns.utterance: What was our total invoiced revenue last month?

turns.must_reference: the calendar month before turn 1's month
turns.fails_if: the window resets to a default range, or is resolved as a rolling window from today

turns.utterance: Show me the open work orders for Harbor Tool & Die Inc.

turns.fails_if: the assistant asks which customer is meant
